Tokai's MediaPipe provenance notice — not an upstream NOTICE file

Runtime
-------
MediaPipe Tasks Vision, @mediapipe/tasks-vision version 1.2.0.
Publisher/author recorded in the official npm package: mediapipe@google.com.
The package declares Apache-2.0. JavaScript and WASM files in this directory
are unmodified copies from that exact package. Their byte counts and SHA-256
identities, plus the npm tarball integrity value, are in manifest.json.

LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt is the complete, unmodified upstream LICENSE, pinned to
google-ai-edge/mediapipe commit ce3cd94f457970502adb855fc723d2d13ae47980.
It includes the upstream license's additional notices; they are retained.
No separate top-level NOTICE file was found in the official repository or
the installed npm package. This notice does not claim to be one.

Gesture Recognizer model
------------------------
gesture_recognizer.task is Google's unmodified float16 version 1 bundle.
Official source:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/gesture_recognizer/gesture_recognizer/float16/1/gesture_recognizer.task
SHA-256:
97952348cf6a6a4915c2ea1496b4b37ebabc50cbbf80571435643c455f2b0482

The model's weight-license field is recorded as NOASSERTION. This means
the reviewed evidence did not establish an explicit redistribution license
for this exact prepackaged bundle. It does not mean public domain, permission
denied, or Apache-2.0 by assumption. The runtime's Apache license is not used
as a substitute for an explicit model-weight license.

Official evidence reviewed:
https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/gesture_recognizer
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/gesture_recognizer/model_card_hand_gesture_classification_with_faireness_2022.pdf
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/blob/master/mediapipe/model_maker/models/gesture_recognizer/BUILD

The BUILD file has an Apache header and a Bazel licenses(["notice"])
classification and lists gesture-classifier, embedder, hand-landmark and
palm-detection assets. This is supporting component evidence, but does not
explicitly identify the complete float16/1 .task bundle or provide a separate
license grant for its exact contents. The linked model card describes uses
and limitations; it does not state an explicit distribution license.

No new license is granted by Tokai for these third-party weights. Resolve the
bundle's redistribution terms before treating them as cleared for general
redistribution. The sync script reproduces the official download and verifies
its identity; it does not settle rights or silently relabel the bundle.

Use and privacy
---------------
The official model card describes hand-control and gesture-recognition uses.
It excludes surveillance/identity recognition and sign-language translation;
it also describes limits with low light, motion blur and other conditions.
Tokai uses local hand landmarks for explicitly enabled controls. Camera
frames are not included in Tokai API messages. This is not a claim of
universal device accuracy or a new privacy statement on behalf of Google.

Recorded 2026-11-03. See manifest.json and README.md for reproducibility.
